issues.description: Method name mismatch for the SealSaloon delivery operation: the problem statement (UML and task text) and the template Main invocation require a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) on SealSaloon, but the reference implementation defines a static method named receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java. This identifier difference (acceptSupplyDelivery vs receiveDelivery) will confuse students and can break example code or automated graders that expect the name from the specification/template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either rename the solution method receiveDelivery(...) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), or add a public static acceptSupplyDelivery(...) wrapper in SealSaloon that delegates to receiveDelivery(...). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template Main to use receiveDelivery(...) if that name is preferred. Ensure tests and example code use the same name.
